newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers no peak firm power for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers no peak firm power for Tuesday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) did not offer any peak firm power for Tuesday pre-schedulings, but contineud to offer non-firm power during off-peak hours, the agency said Monday.
For Monday, BPA had offered 200 megawatts of peak firm power at $16.00-18.00 per megawatt hour (MWh).
For Tuesday, BPA continued to offer non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT at $8.00 per MWh.
Non-firm power for hours ending 0600 and 2300 on Tuesday was also unchanged at $10.00, while prices for hours ending 0700-0800 were steady at $14.00 for COB. Northwest prices rose by $1.00 to $13.00.
